Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification is a prerequisite for the remaining build and testing work. As a result, the delivery date has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing development on all components that don't depend on the certification, so this time is not lost, and we will move directly into final integration and testing as soon as certification clears.

Does this revised date of 14 April still work with your internal planning, or are there constraints on your end we should factor into the schedule? Please let me know, and I'll keep you posted as certification progresses.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
